purpose: Fixed public-rule terrain from sellable shed inventory and shared market state to realized SELL Cash. Battle traces are later projected onto this terrain.

price_rule.coordinate: shared market inventory for the item
price_rule.note: Price is a state function of market inventory, not a fixed function of day or Battle time.

sell_transition.condition: shed[item] > 0 and valid SELL order unit
on_success: farm Cash increases by quoted price
if quoted price > 1, shared market inventory[item] increases by 1
if quoted price == 1, market inventory does not increase
sell_transition.unit_processing: SELL / BUY_* are processed per unit in lockstep. At each unit, both players are quoted from the same pre-commit market inventory for that unit.
sell_transition.price_refresh: After each market order queue slot finishes its per-unit loop, prices for all products are refreshed.

order_surface.note: This limits order-list entries, not the quantity field inside one valid SELL/BUY order.
order_surface.sell_quantity_limit: actual successful units are bounded by shed stock; malformed/failed order stops that order

exogenous_market_demand.processing_order: after player market processing each turn
exogenous_market_demand.town_center_rule: on matching steps, market inventory decreases by 1 for every non-FERTILIZER product
exogenous_market_demand.shop_rule: on matching steps, each unlocked shop instance decreases market inventory by 1 for each listed product; single-product shops decrease by 2
exogenous_market_demand.shop_unlock_rule: at end-of-day, if next_day is a positive multiple of interval and fewer than 8 shop instances exist, one shop is drawn with replacement using deterministic environment RNG keyed by seed and day
exogenous_market_demand.note: The rule is fixed. The realized unlocked-shop path is Battle-seed/state data and belongs to the Battle overlay, not this fixed schedule.

boundaries: No time-only price curve is asserted; price depends on shared market inventory.
No profitability, expected score, asset ranking, or causal interpretation is encoded.
The schedule describes legal market transformation only.
Battle-specific market inventory, unlocked shops, SELL choices and realized prices are overlay data.
Asset State Schedule and Market State Schedule remain separate.
